d: Nitish Setu : bihar men ganga ke oopar bankar taiyar huaa hai ek aisa pul, jo aane vale dinon men lakhon logon ke saphar ka tarika badalne vala hai.... ek aisa pul jisse patna se vaishali pahunchne men ab sava ghante nahin balki mahaj 20 se 25 minat lagenge.... lekin is pul ki charcha sirph iski lanbaee aur raphtar ko lekar nahin ho rahi.... balki iski pahchan ko lekar bhi ek bara phaisla liya gaya hai...aakhir 22.76 kilomitar lanbe is pul ka nam kiske nam par rakha gaya hai...kyon udghatan se pahle hi bihar sarkar ka ye phaisla surkhiyon men aa gaya hai...aur sabse dilchasp bat....is pul…
